blocks.en: Introduction to the Internet: Architecture and Protocols
blocks.zh_html: 互联网导论：体系结构(Architecture)与协议(Protocols)

blocks.en: By Peyrin Kao, based on lectures by Sylvia Ratnasamy, Rob Shakir, and others.
blocks.zh_html: 作者 Peyrin Kao，基于 Sylvia Ratnasamy、Rob Shakir 等人的讲义编写。

blocks.en: These are the course notes for CS 168: Introduction to the Internet at UC Berkeley.
blocks.zh_html: 这是 CS 168：互联网导论(Introduction to the Internet) 在 加州大学伯克利分校（UC Berkeley） 的课程讲义。

blocks.en: Here is the official course description:
blocks.zh_html: 以下是官方课程描述：

blocks.en: This course is an introduction to the Internet architecture. We will focus on the concepts and fundamental design principles that have contributed to the Internet's scalability and robustness and survey the various protocols and algorithms used within this architecture. Topics include layering, addressing, intradomain routing, interdomain routing, reliable delivery, congestion control, and the core protocols (e.g., TCP, UDP, IP, DNS, and HTTP) and network technologies (e.g., Ethernet, wireless).
blocks.zh_html: 本课程介绍互联网体系结构(Internet architecture)。我们将重点介绍推动互联网可扩展性(scalability)和鲁棒性(robustness)的核心概念和基本设计原则，并综述该体系结构中使用的各种协议(protocols)和算法(algorithms)。主题包括分层(layering)、寻址(addressing)、域内路由(intradomain routing)、域间路由(interdomain routing)、可靠交付(reliable delivery)、拥塞控制(congestion control)以及核心协议（如 TCP、UDP、IP、DNS、HTTP）和网络技术（如以太网(Ethernet)、无线网络(wireless)）。
